description:
***Available 30th September***

Zuker Property is delighted to present this stunning two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment situated on the 19th floor of a modern development. 

The property boasts a spacious open-plan living and dining area, seamlessly connected to a fully equipped contemporary kitchen with integrated appliances, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Large floor-to-ceiling windows flood the space with natural light, while the private balcony offers far-reaching views of the surrounding cityscape, creating an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Both bedrooms are generously sized, with the master bedroom benefiting from an en-suite bathroom for added convenience.

The development benefits from a 24-hour concierge service at the lobby, secure entry to the main building, as well as exclusive access to the residents' lounge and terrace.

Transport Links
South Bermondsey Station is just a 10-minute walk, with a swift 5-minute direct journey to London Bridge-providing seamless access to Jubilee and Northern lines as well as National Rail services.
Multiple bus routes also serve the area, providing convenient connections to South and Central London.

Local Amenities
Situated in a vibrant neighborhood, this location benefits from the ongoing regeneration of Bermondsey, known for its lively mix of shops, cafés, restaurants, and leisure options-all within easy reach.
